headline: Signs your baby already knows your lullaby
items: They settle at the first line, before you've even sat down
They turn toward you when someone else tries to sing it
They fuss at the same spot every night, right on cue
They go heavy in your arms halfway through the second verse

cta.eyebrow:
They're already learning a song.
Why not one with their name in it?
cta.ask:
Make a lullaby just for
your little one, free
